name: rush_hour_benchmark_570_minmove_3_30
description: This benchmark measures the ability of planners or RL agents to solve Rush Hour sliding-block puzzles (instances with a minimum solution length between 3 and 30 moves). It evaluates whether agents can find valid solutions and compares efficiency in terms of moves and success rate across 570 instances.
evaluation_method: task_success_rate (often reported with average moves-to-solve and time-to-solve)
general_score_metric: task_success_rate (with average solution length as a secondary metric)
reputation: A focused, task-specific benchmark hosted on Hugging Face used by planning/RL researchers; relatively niche but useful for comparative studies.
